Major Benefits of Commercial Carpet Cleaning

September 11, 2020

Besides buying white upholstered furniture or leather couches, your luxurious carpets provide a quick lift of your home and office’s curb appeal. You can shop for different designs and palettes of carpets from various stores and manufacturers.

However, your beautiful carpets also serve as a good magnet of dust, pet danders, molds, and mildews. You need to perform daily vacuuming on your carpets to remove that top-layer dirt and grime.

Nevertheless, you can also hire a commercial carpet cleaning serviceto periodically deep clean your soiled carpets. Shiny Carpet Cleaningis one of the authorities when it comes to reliable commercial carpet cleaning methods. Give us a short call today to know more about our services.

Amazing Benefits of Commercial Carpet Cleaning that Will Save You Time

Is it expensive to hire a local carpet cleaner? For a reasonable cost, you are avoiding heftier investments from purchasing new carpets when you hire a trustworthy carpet cleaning service.

Moreover, we can take care of your whole office cleaning requirements without breaking a bank. Give us a quick call today, so you can talk to our cleaning consultants for advice.

Here are the best advantages when you can deeply sanitize and disinfect your carpets from a trusted local commercial steam carpet cleaningservice.

1. Prolongs Carpet Life

Professional carpet cleaners like Shiny Carpet Cleaning knows the nitty-gritty detail of standard commercial carpet cleaning methods. We have different methods of sanitizing your carpets, and these include the following: steam cleaning, encapsulation, bonnet cleaning, dry cleaning, and shampooing.

Our cleaners will only use EPA-approved cleaning products and disinfectants to effectively remove those stains and foul odor present in your carpets. Once all these dirt and pathogens are removed, it restores and preserves its fabric construction and aesthetics.

2. Boosts the Integrity and Appeal of Your Business

When you make your office presentable and clean, you are putting a great and reliable impression on your prospective clients. In line, keeping your carpets clean and pleasing lifts the curb appeal and professionalism of your office.

Shiny Carpet Cleaning can be your best partner for your all-around commercial cleaning requirements. We offer an array of sanitation and disinfection services to maintain the cool and crisp ambiance inside your office.

3. Preserves Your Investment

Carpets can come at different palettes and patterns, yet they all have one thing in common, that is, expensive price. It is never cheap to buy a lucrative carpet that shall add confidence and elegance in your homes and offices.

For a cost-efficient price, hiring a professional commercial carpet cleaning serviceis a good strategy to preserve your investment in purchasing your carpets. The average cost for commercial carpet cleaningis more economical than purchasing one or two new carpets as replacements for your old ones.

4. Keeps A Clean Office Environment

Most offices and business establishments have high foot traffic which brings all sorts of dirt and grime in your carpets. Leaving your soiled carpets uncleaned can serve as a breeding ground for pathogens, molds, and mildews.

These tiny creatures produce a foul odor that pollutes the indoor air in your office, thereby putting everyone’s health at risk. Fortunately, you can avail of our commercial steam carpet cleaning at a reasonable cost to sanitize and decontaminate your heavily soiled carpets.

With that, there will be fewer chances of absences and allergies from everyone in your office. A clean and cool office will boost the productivity of your employees.

5. Cost-efficient and Hassle-free Means of Stain Removal

Local carpet cleaners like Shiny Carpet Cleaning have sufficient knowledge and cleaning materials to safely remove organic and inorganic stains on your carpets. Our cleaners gained the best training and experience to efficiently remove common stains like wine, coffee, kool-aide, chocolate, sauce, food crumbs, and inks.

Our carpet cleaners will first inspect the stain and fabric type of your carpets before applying the most suitable stain removal technique. Further, we only use green stain removers to preserve both the environment and your fabric.

We have industrial-rated cleaning machines such as truck mounts, HEPA vacuums, stackable air movers, dehumidifiers, and UV light wand for disinfection. Consequently, we can routinely meet your carpet cleaning standards all the time.

6. Flexible Carpet Cleaning Without Interrupting Your Schedule

We understand that all business establishments have a tight schedule in keeping their operations run smoothly. No matter how hectic your schedule, Shiny Carpet Cleaning can easily work our way around it.

Our talented personnel have the best experience for cleaning carpets even at the busiest time of the day. We will use compact carpet cleaning equipment and dry cleaning methods to avoid any interruptions with your workflow. Moreover, we are going to do spot cleaning when necessary.

We are passionate about providing cost-efficient carpet cleaning solutions for all business owners in Maryland, Northern Virginia, and Washington DC. Our innovative carpet cleaning protocols shall effectively regain the aesthetics and cleanliness of your elegant carpets.
